### ✅ T02 · Typing core

**Status:** Done · **Finished:** 2026-11-10 · **Pull request:** [PR #3](https://github.com/shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot/pull/3)

The typing engine every scene and mode will use now exists as pure logic: keyboard layouts for Hebrew and English, a session that judges each key, and scoring with per-key, per-finger and habit hints.

**What changed**

- src/core/layouts.ts: Hebrew (Israeli) and English (QWERTY) layouts by KeyboardEvent.code with finger, hand, row, shift layer, final letters, niqqud helpers, key lookup by character and text normaliser
- src/core/session.ts: TypingSession (judged TypedKey out, errors never block, backspace policy allowed/disabled/mustFix, hardcore flag, niqqud ignore/required, works whatever the OS keyboard language is)
- src/core/metrics.ts: gross and net WPM, accuracy, consistency, WPM timeline, rolling WPM, per-key and per-finger stats, confusion pairs, wrong-finger / home-row-drift / slow-key hints
- tests/unit/core-layouts.test.ts and tests/unit/core-session.test.ts: 46 new tests incl. recorded Hebrew and English sessions and mixed Hebrew/English lines
- docs/ROADMAP.md: T02 ticked

**Decisions**

- **The session takes the time as an argument instead of reading a clock** — Keeps core pure and makes recorded-session tests exact
- **Kept the reference shift layer (( on Shift+9 for Hebrew) and the swapped < > ; added mirrored brackets and backslash** — Port behaviour from 4.2.0; brackets were missing there
- **Niqqud marks can be typed in any order and a letter typed while marks are owed counts as a missed mark** — Errors must never block the player
- **Net WPM = gross WPM minus mistakes per minute, as in the 4.2.0 engine** — Keeps scores comparable with the old plugin

**Notes**

Timing-based hints use simple thresholds; T06 (adaptive engine) may tune them.

### ✅ T03 · Saves and profiles

**Status:** Done · **Finished:** 2026-11-10 · **Pull request:** [PR #4](https://github.com/shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot/pull/4)

Saves now exist as pure logic: several local profiles, a versioned save with migrations, browser and Otzaria storage chosen at boot, autosave that keeps the last good copy, JSON export/import and a one-time import of old plugin progress.

**What changed**

- src/save/schema.ts: Save/Profile types from ARCHITECTURE section 4, defaults, tolerant normaliser that repairs bad fields
- src/save/migrations.ts: CURRENT_VERSION 1, migration chain, v0 (unversioned) to v1, refuses saves from newer versions
- src/save/store.ts: SaveStore with localStorage, Otzaria (storage.get/set with a local mirror) and memory adapters; detectStore picks at boot
- src/save/manager.ts: SaveManager with load + recovery (primary, then last good copy, then fresh), debounced autosave, profile create/rename/delete/switch, export/import JSON
- src/save/legacy.ts: one-time import of old plugin progress (hebtyper_data_v2) into a new profile
- src/main.ts: creates the SaveManager at boot, loads it, flushes on pagehide
- tests/unit/save-*.test.ts: 40 new tests (round-trip, migration, corrupt recovery, both adapters with a mocked Otzaria, profiles, export/import, legacy import)
- docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, CHANGELOG.md updated

**Decisions**

- **Version 0 is the unversioned early shape and the current version is 1** — There was no older released format; this proves the migration chain works and leaves a clear place for the next change
- **Hand-written validation instead of adding a schema library** — Keeps the bundle small and avoids a new dependency; the normaliser repairs fields instead of rejecting the whole save
- **Every autosave first copies the previous good save to a backup key** — A half-written main save can then always be recovered from the last good copy
- **A broken or too-new save is kept under otiyot_save_unreadable and a too-new save is never overwritten** — Nothing the player earned is lost by an update or a downgrade
- **Importing a profile file adds profiles (new ids on clash) unless replace is asked for** — Safer: importing can never wipe existing profiles by accident
- **Deleting the last profile creates a fresh one** — The game always has a player
- **Added meta.legacyChecked and createdAt to the schema** — Makes the old-plugin import happen once only

**To do**

- [ ] The UI for choosing, creating, renaming and exporting profiles comes with the design system and title screen (T07, T12)
- [ ] Legacy import maps statistics and completed lessons only; old lesson ids are kept as they are and will be matched to the new tracks in T04

**Notes**

Typed text is never stored. The manager is exported from src/main.ts as `saves` for later tasks.

### ✅ T04 · The two lesson tracks

**Status:** Done · **Finished:** 2026-11-10 · **Pull request:** [PR #6](https://github.com/shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot/pull/6)

Both built-in lesson courses now exist as pure logic for Hebrew and English: Track 1 (letter by letter, from plugin 3.3.0) and Track 2 (two keys per lesson with real words, from plugin 4.2.0). Each profile picks a track, progress is kept separately per track and language, and a text source hands scenes the next text from the active track.

**What changed**

- src/learn/track.ts: TRACK_1 and TRACK_2 with levels, lesson lists, titles and tips in both UI languages, unlock rule (70% of the previous level), find-next-lesson, 90% pass mark
- src/learn/text1.ts and text2.ts: faithful ports of the lesson text generators of plugins 3.3.0 and 4.2.0 (character drills, word drills, Level 1 lessons, pseudo-words, final letters, niqqud level) with an injected random source
- src/learn/data/banks.ts, curriculum.ts, lexicon.ts: word banks, sentences, paragraphs, key orders, level names and the Track 2 lexicon, generated from reference/ by scripts/extract-learn-data.mjs
- src/learn/progress.ts: per-track and per-language progress on the profile, record a finished lesson (pass/best), switch track without losing progress
- src/learn/source.ts: nextText, nextContinueText and lessonForBand give a scene band its text from the profile active track
- tests/unit/learn-harness.ts, learn-tracks.test.ts, learn-progress.test.ts: the original plugin code runs in a sandbox and its lessons, titles, tips, unlock rule and generated text are compared with the ports for both tracks, both languages and several seeds; plus switching, progress and content-rule tests
- docs/ROADMAP.md ticked, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 5 and CHANGELOG.md updated

**Decisions**

- **The one niqqud sample taken from a verse (it contained a holy Name) was replaced with a plain greeting** — Content rules in ARCHITECTURE section 8 are binding: no holy Names and no pesukim as typing text
- **Progress is stored under profile.lessons["1"]/["2"] for Hebrew and "1-en"/"2-en" for English** — Both languages reuse the same lesson ids, so they need separate lists; the existing save schema needed no change and no migration
- **The active level is derived from the highest passed lesson instead of being stored** — Same result as the old setActiveLevel on passing, and one less thing to keep in sync
- **Weak keys, weak transitions and the difficulty level are inputs to the text generators, not computed here** — The adaptive engine is task T06; defaults (no weak keys, difficulty 0.3) match a new learner in the original
- **The 4.1 "keep unlocked after key-order migration" list and the frequent-word chunk drills were not ported** — The first only migrates old saves; the second is not part of the lesson list and belongs with the adaptive engine (T06)
- **Pass mark default is 90% as set in ARCHITECTURE, configurable per call** — The old plugin used the accuracy-target setting capped at 97%; the roadmap asks for 90% by default

**To do**

- [ ] T05 should extend src/learn/data/lexicon.ts (the Track 2 lexicon) into the full word library
- [ ] T06 should feed weak keys, weak transitions and the difficulty level into TextContext and port the chunk drills
- [ ] Legacy import (src/save/legacy.ts) files old English progress under lessons["2"]; it should use the "1-en"/"2-en" keys and map old lesson ids to the right track (L1-n = Track 1, L1p-n = Track 2)

**Notes**

Run node scripts/extract-learn-data.mjs && pnpm exec prettier --write src/learn/data to regenerate the data files.

### ✅ T05 · Word and sentence library

**Status:** Done · **Finished:** 2026-11-10 · **Pull request:** [PR #8](https://github.com/shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot/pull/8)

A built-in library of over 4,000 Hebrew and 4,200 English words in themed packs and 360 sentences per language now exists as pure logic, with difficulty tiers, a key-limited filter weighted toward weak keys, and personal word lists stored on the profile. Every pack is scanned by a content test with a blocklist of holy Names.

**What changed**

- src/learn/library/data-he.ts and data-en.ts: word packs (everyday, home, market, numbers, travel, sea, sky, desert, holidays, nature, school; Hebrew also extra) and sentence packs (everyday, home, market, travel, sea-and-sky, desert, holidays, proverbs)
- src/learn/library/index.ts: wordsOf, sentencesOf, tierOf, eligibleWords, pickWords (allowed keys, length, tier, pack, weak-key weighting), parseWordList, setCustomList, removeCustomList; older lexicon kept as the classic pack
- src/save/schema.ts and migrations.ts: Profile.customLists, save version 2 with a v1 to v2 migration
- tests/unit/library-content.test.ts and library-api.test.ts: amounts, packs, no duplicates, typeable plain text, holy-Names blocklist, filter, custom lists, migration
- docs/ROADMAP.md ticked, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md sections 4 and 5, CHANGELOG.md updated

**Decisions**

- **Word and sentence drafts were written by Haiku helper agents, then checked by scripts and tests (letters only, final letters, no duplicates, blocklist) and spot-read** — CLAUDE.md allows cheaper helpers for bulk lists; tests make the content rules binding
- **Sentences are original short sayings, no punctuation or capitals** — The typing engine has no punctuation keys in the lesson text and ARCHITECTURE section 8 forbids pesukim as typing text
- **Tiers are by word length; row coverage is answered by the allowed-key filter** — Keeps one simple rule; lessons pass the key set they have taught
- **Custom lists capped at 20 lists, 2,000 words each, 24 letters per word** — Keeps saves small; only words are stored, never typed text

**To do**

- [ ] The Hebrew word packs contain some English-transliterated Hebrew words in the English holidays pack (for example shalom, challah); a native-speaker review of both libraries is worthwhile
- [ ] Screens for choosing packs and managing custom lists come with the mode tasks (T31)

**Notes**

Frequency tiers use pack order and the classic top-word list only; there is no corpus-based ranking.

### ✅ T06 · Adaptive engine and spaced repetition

**Status:** Done · **Finished:** 2026-11-10 · **Pull request:** [PR #10](https://github.com/shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot/pull/10)

The adaptive engine is now pure logic in src/learn/adaptive.ts: it learns per-key, per-finger and per-letter-pair skill, picks weak keys and transitions, schedules spaced reviews, keeps difficulty near the 92 to 96 percent accuracy band, and builds drills deterministically from a seed. TextSource now fills weak keys and difficulty from the player's profile automatically.

**What changed**

- src/learn/adaptive.ts: charMastery, pairMastery, skillState, recordKeystroke, recordRetentionCheck, weakCharacters, weakBigrams, topErrorPairs, fingerSkills, dueToday, recordChallenge, difficultyParams, generateCharDrill, generateBigramDrill, generateErrorDrill, generateWordDrill, buildMicroLesson, unlockGate, adaptiveOptions
- src/learn/source.ts: contextFor takes weak keys, weak transitions and difficulty from the adaptive engine unless the caller supplies them
- src/learn/index.ts: exports the adaptive module
- tests/unit/learn-adaptive.test.ts: 30 tests (mastery, weak keys, bounded over-sampling of weak keys, determinism, review dates, due list, retention checks, difficulty controller, unlock gate, micro lesson, finger skills)
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (adaptive section), CHANGELOG.md, docs/ROADMAP.md ticked

**Decisions**

- **Spaced-repetition and challenge state is stored inside profile.srs as plain JSON, with no save schema change** — profile.srs was reserved for this task and is already an open JSON record, so no migration is needed and old saves keep working
- **Dropped the plugin's slow-common-words and chunk drills; word drills use the T05 library weights instead** — The library already weights words toward weak keys; keeping two word pickers would duplicate logic
- **Weak-key share in drills is clamped to 15-50 percent** — Keeps the drill feeling like natural typing while still over-sampling weak keys, as the done-when test requires
- **The unlock gate only blocks on keys that have at least 3 attempts and score under 70** — A new player with no data must not be stalled

**To do**

- [ ] Scenes and Practice mode (later tasks) must call recordKeystroke per key and save the returned keys and srs; the engine does not touch the save itself

**Notes**

Hebrew words in labels are not needed here: challengeLabel returns a code (guarded, growing, challenging, advanced) that the UI maps to locale strings later.

### ✅ T07 · Design system and UI shell

**Status:** Done · **Finished:** 2026-11-10 · **Pull request:** [PR #12](https://github.com/shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot/pull/12)

The game now has its real look and its menus: parchment and night-ink themes, bundled Hebrew and Latin fonts, every core component, Hebrew (right to left) and English menus, and a first-run welcome that sets up a player with a name, a keyboard and a lesson track.

**What changed**

- src/ui/styles/tokens.css: all design tokens (light, dark, colorblind, high contrast, large text, dyslexia font, reduce motion); base.css, components.css, screens.css use tokens only
- src/ui/styles/fonts.css: bundled fonts from @fontsource (Frank Ruhl Libre, Assistant, Noto Sans Hebrew, Noto Sans, OpenDyslexic), woff2, Hebrew and Latin subsets only
- src/engine/palette.ts: the same colors for 3D, kept identical to tokens.css and the DESIGN.md table by a test
- src/ui/i18n.ts + locales/he.json + locales/en.json (179 strings each): language loader, direction switching, helpers for text that mixes Hebrew and English
- src/ui/hotkeys.ts + src/ui/components/menu.ts: every menu item can be chosen by typing its gold letter, by arrows and Enter, or by mouse; Esc goes back
- src/ui/components: button, field, toggle, slider, select, tabs, panel with deckled paper edge, key-cap chip, status, stat tile, progress bar, rank badge, dialogue box with portrait and captions, toast, modal, keyboard map and key heatmap, line chart, choice card (track picker card), menu
- src/ui/shell.ts + src/ui/app.ts: top bar (back, player, language, theme), screen switching by address (#/menu, #/players, #/track, #/layout, #/settings, #/pause), one keyboard listener
- Screens in src/ui/screens: main menu, players (switch, add, rename, delete), new player in three steps and first-run welcome, lesson track picker with a plain explanation and the real first keys of each track, keyboard picker with a mini keyboard, settings skeleton (Display, Sound, Typing), pause menu
- src/ui/screens/styleguide.ts: #/styleguide page, development only, showing every token and component in light, dark, RTL and LTR
- src/ui/theme.ts: applies theme and accessibility switches to the page
- Save schema v3 (src/save/schema.ts, migrations.ts): settings gain theme, colorblind, highContrast, largeText, dyslexiaFont, with a migration and test
- src/main.ts, index.html: boot now loads the save and starts the shell; the placeholder boot screen and boot.css are gone
- Tests: tests/unit/ui-i18n.test.ts, ui-hotkeys.test.ts, ui-tokens.test.ts, a v2 to v3 migration test, and tests/e2e/shell.spec.ts (first run, Hebrew keyboard-only menus, pause menu) at 1280x720 and 375px
- Docs: ARCHITECTURE.md (new section 5b and the settings fields), DESIGN.md, ASSETS.md (fonts and licences), CHANGELOG.md, ROADMAP.md ticked

**Decisions**

- **Menu letters also work through the physical key, on both layouts** — A Hebrew menu must still answer when the computer keyboard is set to English (and the other way round); otherwise the gold letters would seem broken to half the players.
- **Added five display settings to the save (schema v3) now instead of waiting for T36** — Theme, colorblind, high contrast, large text and dyslexia font are part of the token system and must be remembered per player; T36 can build on them.
- **New player steps are name, then keyboard, then lesson track** — The track cards show the real first keys of each track, which depend on the keyboard chosen.
- **On a first visit the three steps fill in the player that every new save already has, instead of adding a second one** — Otherwise every device would start with an unused player called Player.
- **Screens are addressed by the part after # in the address (for example #/settings)** — It works the same on the website and inside Otzaria, where the game is opened from a folder, and makes every screen testable.
- **The Journey item is shown on the main menu but faded and marked Soon** — The story arrives in T12 and T13; a faded, un-restored item fits the world and is honest about what is not built yet.
- **Fonts are declared by hand (woff2 only, Hebrew and Latin subsets, only the weights used)** — The ready-made @fontsource stylesheets would also ship older woff files and unused subsets and roughly double the size of the Otzaria plugin. OpenDyslexic is the largest single file (115 KB).
- **The styleguide is left out of the real build** — DESIGN.md says it is for development only. To see it: pnpm dev, then open #/styleguide.
- **Charts and the keyboard picture always run left to right, also in Hebrew** — A physical keyboard does not mirror, and time on a chart reads left to right in both languages.
- **The frontend-design skill named in the roadmap was not available in the unattended run** — The design was worked out from DESIGN.md directly and checked by looking at screenshots at 1366x768 and 375px, in both languages and themes.

- [ ] Sound sliders save their values but nothing plays until the audio engine (T10).
- [ ] The pause menu is ready but only reachable at #/pause until scenes call it (T08 onward).
- [ ] T36 adds the remaining settings (shake and flash sliders, text speed, health reminders).

Built by the Fable runner (Fable 5.2, effort High) on the second attempt; the first run left no branch. Website build is about 380 KB in total, of which 115 KB is the optional OpenDyslexic font. ### ✅ T08 · 3D engine kit

**Status:** Done · **Finished:** 2026-11-10 · **Pull request:** [PR #14](https://github.com/shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot/pull/14)

The game now has its 3D foundation: a renderer with four graphics presets that picks the right one for each computer, lighting, fog, shadows and screen effects, a camera rig, a kit of gold-ink effects, modest robed characters animated by code, scene loading behind an ink wipe, and a test range that shows all of it.

**What changed**

- src/engine/engine.ts + loop.ts: one renderer, resize handling, fixed 1/60 s logic steps, hit-stop, frame statistics, simulate() for tests, dispose() that reports anything left on the graphics card
- src/engine/quality.ts: presets low, medium, high, ultra and the 2-second first-run benchmark that picks one from measured frame times; budgets 150 draw calls and 300k triangles on medium
- src/engine/materials.ts: MaterialKit, the one place surfaces are made, with the grey-to-color restoration sweep (gold wavefront, up to 6 at once), height fog with sun glow, flat low-poly shading
- src/engine/lighting.ts: Atmosphere (sky, one hero sun, fill light, fog) with blob shadows on low, one shadow map on medium, three cascaded shadow maps on high and ultra
- src/engine/postfx.ts: bloom, screen-space god rays, SSAO on high and ultra, chromatic-aberration hit pulse, tone mapping, color grading, screen flash, vignette
- src/engine/camera.ts: camera rig with third-person follow and collision, rail and cockpit modes, shake and push-in; modes glide into each other
- src/engine/vfx.ts: pooled effects moved by the graphics card: gold sparks, ink splashes, ink trails, letters breaking into fragments, shockwaves, restoration sweep, flash, combined impact
- src/engine/letters.ts: every Hebrew and Latin letter drawn once into one texture; many floating letters in a single draw call
- src/engine/character.ts + characterAnim.ts: modest robed figures (hat, cap or head scarf, optional beard and quill) with idle, walk, run, write, hit, stagger, fall, cheer and smooth blending
- src/engine/scene.ts + transition.ts + disposal.ts: the GameScene and SceneContext contract, SceneManager, ink-wipe loading transition, disposal tracking with a leak check after every scene
- src/engine/perf.ts: performance overlay (frames per second, frame time, draw calls, triangles, GPU objects, preset); compact on phones
- src/scenes/range + src/ui/screens/range.ts + src/ui/styles/engine.css: the test range at #/range with buttons and number keys for every effect, camera, animation and preset; typing the floating word restores color
- src/save/schema.ts + migrations.ts: save version 4 adds settings.quality and meta.autoQuality, with a migration and test
- locales/he.json + locales/en.json: all test range and overlay strings in Hebrew and English
- tests/unit/engine-kit.test.ts (20 tests) and tests/e2e/range.spec.ts (full tour, budget check, zero leaked GPU objects after closing); playwright.config.ts lets the test browser draw 3D in software
- package.json: added the libraries three and postprocessing (listed in ASSETS.md)
- docs: ARCHITECTURE section 7b (engine kit) and save v4, DESIGN 3D art direction note, CHANGELOG, ASSETS, ROADMAP tick
- src/learn/source.ts: learnedWordSource, words built only from the letters the player has already learned (real words when enough letters are known, short letter drills before that); the test range uses it; tests/unit/learned-words.test.ts checks both languages and both tracks
- src/engine/character.ts: headwear is a cap, a brimmed hat or a turban; the head scarf was removed and the walking figure in the range is now a bearded man in a turban

**Decisions**

- **Use the postprocessing library for screen effects instead of writing every pass by hand** — It merges effects into one or two full-screen passes, which is what keeps bloom, god rays and grading affordable on integrated graphics.
- **All surfaces are made by one MaterialKit that shares one set of shader inputs** — The color sweep, fog and theme then work on every object in every scene without scene authors thinking about it, and a sweep costs nothing per material.
- **Effects are animated on the graphics card from ring buffers** — Spawning an effect writes a few numbers; nothing is allocated while playing, which the performance rules require.
- **The benchmark runs on medium and judges steadiness, not just average speed** — A browser never draws faster than the screen, so high is only chosen when 95 percent of frames are on time.
- **The draw-call budget is enforced on low and medium only** — ARCHITECTURE sets the budget for medium; high and ultra spend extra draw calls on cascaded shadows by design (about 260 in the range).
- **On the night-ink theme the forgotten-world grey is lifted to a moonlit level** — The dark fade token is nearly black; when I looked at the range in the dark theme the whole ground was pure black. It is now dim but readable.
- **The test range is reached by address (#/range) and is not in the menus** — It is a tool for building scenes, not part of the game.
- **Audio and HUD are silent stand-ins in SceneContext for now** — They are built in T09 and T10; scenes written today will not need changing when they arrive.
- **With reduce motion on, shake, push-in, flash, chromatic pulse and hit-stop are switched off completely** — Those are exactly the effects that bother motion-sensitive players; color sweeps and particles stay.
- **Applied the two new owner rules (merged into main while this task was being built) inside this task** — They are binding for every task: the range had one figure in a head scarf that could be read as a woman, and its words came from the whole library instead of the learned letters.
- **Before enough letters are learned to spell real words, the range shows short drills made of the learned letters** — A new player knows only two keys; nothing unlearned may ever be asked, so drills are the only honest text.

**Manual steps**

1. **Check the frame rate on a real computer** (⬜ open)

   The cloud build machine has no graphics card, so real speed could not be measured there. On your own computer open the live link, add #/range to the end of the address, click Medium under Quality and read the first line of the small box in the corner: it should say about 60 and not be red. Needs the live link from the T01 step (Import the repo into Vercel).

   Prompt for Claude in Chrome:

   ```text
   Open the live Otiyot website in my browser (the Vercel address of the project shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot; if you do not know it, open https://vercel.com/dashboard, open the project named otiyot and use its production address; if asked to sign in, stop and hand control back to me). Steps: 1) Add #/range to the end of the address and press Enter. 2) If the welcome steps appear, type the name Test, press Enter, then click Next twice, then go to the #/range address again. 3) Wait about 5 seconds until the 3D scene appears. 4) In the Quality group click Medium. 5) Wait 5 seconds, then read the small box in the top corner: frames per second, frame time, draw calls, triangles. 6) Press the number keys 1 to 9 one at a time and read frames per second again. 7) Click High and read the numbers once more. Stop and hand control back to me for sign-in, passwords, 2FA, CAPTCHAs, payment and creating an account; never type a secret yourself. When done, report the numbers you read for Medium and High, whether any number was shown in red, and what computer and browser this is.
   ```

**To do**

- [ ] Real frame rate on integrated graphics is not yet confirmed (see the manual step); the measured load on medium is about 95 draw calls and 25k triangles, well inside the budget.
- [ ] There is no graphics quality picker in Settings yet; for now it can only be changed in the test range. T36 adds it.
- [ ] Scenes get silent audio and an empty HUD until T09 (HUD) and T10 (audio) are built.
- [ ] The engine code is about 740 KB (187 KB compressed) and is loaded only when a 3D screen opens; menus do not pay for it.
- [ ] The test range has no Easy / Standard / Hard levels: it is a developer tool, not a playable scene. Levels arrive with the combat and difficulty kit (T11).

**Notes**

Built by the Fable runner (Fable 5.2, effort Xhigh) over three attempts: the first two built the engine and the test range, the third looked at it in Chromium in both themes, fixed the black night theme and the phone overlay, and added the tests and docs. To try: open the live link, add #/range to the address, type the floating word and press the number keys 1 to 9; the arrow keys change the camera.

### ✅ T09 · 3D keyboard, finger guide, HUD and typing feedback

**Status:** Done · **Finished:** 2026-11-10 · **Pull request:** [PR #15](https://github.com/shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot/pull/15)

Typing now feels alive: a paper strip shows the word letter by letter with the next word dimmed, a tilted 3D keyboard under the game lights the next key in its finger color (also right after a mistake), a combo meter grows and changes material, and every key lands in the 3D world with gold ink, while mistakes blink the world grey without ever blocking.

**What changed**

- src/game/typing.ts: TypingDriver turns a text source into words (each finished by its space), judges keys with the typing core, keeps letter states, lookahead, combo and best combo, combo tiers, WPM, accuracy and metrics, and gives the finger guide its next key (Backspace when a mistake must be fixed); lesson (once) and endless modes
- src/game/hints.ts: HintCoach shows rare, kind tips after mistakes: wrong finger (names the finger) and hands drifting off the home row; at most one per 25 seconds
- src/game/feedback.ts: TypingFeedback, the shared 3D feel: gold ink stroke, sparks and ink drops and a small combo-scaled knock per right key; stumble and desaturate flicker per wrong key; gold ring, shockwave and impact per word
- src/engine/worldText.ts: WorldText shows the word in the world as carved stone, a parchment banner or a hologram, right to left for Hebrew, colored by letter state
- src/engine/scene.ts: SceneContext.typing (TypingView) and GameScene.onWord; SceneManager.onWord; src/engine/postfx.ts: setSaturationScale for the error flicker
- src/ui/hud.ts + src/ui/styles/hud.css: HUD with combo meter (ink, techelet, silver, gold, light), WPM and accuracy pills, paper strip with per-letter states and lookahead, lesson progress bar, tips and gold announcements; implements the scene HudPort
- src/ui/keyboardGuide.ts: CSS-3D tilted keyboard in the active layout (other layout small in the corner), finger color coding, next key raised in techelet, Shift to hold, press animation, optional hands, caption naming key and finger
- src/ui/play.ts: PlayController wires keyboard -> typing driver -> HUD, guide, hint coach -> SceneManager.onKey / onWord
- Design tokens: --finger-pinky, --finger-ring, --finger-middle, --finger-index, --finger-thumb (light and dark, mirrored in palette.ts and DESIGN.md), --key-u and --key-tilt
- Save v5: settings.keyboardGuide (keys, hands, off) with migration and test; Settings > Typing has a Keyboard guide choice
- Test range: types the current lesson with an end card (Enter for the next) or endless learned words; pickers for text style and keyboard guide; world word moved higher
- Locales: HUD, guide, finger names, tips, settings and range strings in Hebrew and English
- Tests: tests/unit/game-typing.test.ts (driver, guide after errors, must-fix, lessons, hardcore, WPM, combo tiers, hint coach, RTL layout, learned letters only), v4->v5 migration test, token test now also checks engine.css and hud.css; e2e range test types whole lessons in English and Hebrew by following the guide
- Fixed a female name in the range e2e test save (content rule)
- Docs: ARCHITECTURE 7c Typing in play, DESIGN tokens and in-play components, CHANGELOG, ROADMAP tick

**Decisions**

- **The 3D keyboard is drawn with CSS 3D transforms over the canvas, not in WebGL** — Crisp glyphs in both layouts, token colors and themes for free, no second WebGL context or extra draw calls, and it works in the plugin
- **Each word is typed together with the space after it, and the space finishes the word** — Touch typing includes the space bar; it also gives a clear moment for the word-done effect
- **Mistakes follow the profile backspace setting (default: the cursor moves on, Backspace can fix; must-fix shows Backspace in the guide)** — Keeps the typing core rules from T02; nothing ever blocks unless the player chose must-fix
- **Tips only after a mistake, at most one per 25 s and the same tip once per 90 s** — Owner asked for gentle hints; frequent tips would nag
- **Combo tiers at 10, 25, 50 and 100 correct keys in a row** — Reachable early for learners, still special at the top
- **Five new finger color tokens** — Finger coding needs distinct hues and DESIGN forbids colors outside the tokens
- **The test range does not record lesson results** — It is a developer tool; real lesson recording belongs to the scenes and the hub

**To do**

- [ ] Sounds for keys, errors and words come with the audio engine (T10); scenes already call audio.play(key, error, space, restore)

**Notes**

Try it on the live site at #/range: type the word on the paper strip and press space after each word.

### ✅ T10 · Audio engine and first music themes

**Status:** Done · **Finished:** 2026-11-10 · **Pull request:** [PR #16](https://github.com/shlomyeisenberg-lang/Otiyot/pull/16)

The game now has sound, all made in code: five music themes that build layer by layer with your streak and always change on the beat, key clicks that climb the music's own scale, a soft knock for mistakes, menu sounds, place sounds that can come from a point in the world, four volume sliders and a sound room to hear everything.

**What changed**

- src/audio/theory.ts: modes (freygish, minor, dorian, mi sheberach), scale degrees to notes, the pentatonic click ladder (two octaves up and back), seeded random numbers, volume curve
- src/audio/themes.ts: five themes as data: title (D freygish, 60, clarinet, 6/8), hub (G minor, 80, oud, brushes, swung), meadow (A dorian, 112, flute, darbuka), cliffs (E mi sheberach, 92, violin, kanun, 6/8), boss (C freygish, 138, strings, cello ostinato, taiko, three phases with the last one a semitone higher)
- src/audio/composer.ts: the composer writes every bar of five stems (drone, pulse, melody, counter-melody, percussion); melodies in 4-bar phrases following a contour, ending each section on the tonic, with ornaments that change on every visit so ten minutes never loop exactly; stemLevels and tierIntensity (which stems play at which combo tier); BarClock holds intensity, section and boss-phase changes until the next bar line
- src/audio/synth.ts: instruments made from oscillators, filters and noise: pad, harp, oud, kanun, flute, clarinet, violin, strings, cello, bell; darbuka, frame drum, taiko and brush kits; a hall reverb made from decaying noise
- src/audio/sfx.ts: one-shot sounds: key (wooden tap coloured per character plus a note on the ladder, brighter per tier), space, error (low muted knock), word, perfect, restore, tier chime, impact, impact-small, shatter, whoosh, success, and menu sounds ui-move, ui-click, ui-back, ui-open, ui-toggle, ui-error
- src/audio/ambience.ts: looping place sounds wind, birds, water, fire, crickets, machine hum, each optionally at a point in the world
- src/audio/engine.ts: AudioEngine: starts only after the first key press or click (browser rule), mixer with music, effects, voice and menu buses plus limiter, music ducking under errors and impacts, look-ahead scheduler, stems fading over one beat at bar lines, positional one-shots and ambience (HRTF), listener, pause while the tab is hidden, status snapshot, offline render for tests
- src/engine/scene.ts: AudioPort grows playAt, section, ambience, clearAmbience and listen (SILENT_AUDIO updated); SceneManager points the ears along the camera every frame and stops ambience when a scene unloads
- src/ui/shell.ts + src/ui/app.ts: one AudioEngine for the app (AppContext.audio), volumes applied from settings, menus play the title theme softly, menu sounds on clicks, keyboard moves and Back; Screen.ownsMusic
- src/ui/screens/sound.ts + screens.css: the sound room at #/sound (from Settings > Sound): theme cards, streak-level slider, stem lamps, a typing pad that builds a real streak, boss phase buttons, stop, place sounds and every effect
- src/ui/screens/settings.ts: Sound tab has four volume sliders (music, effects, voice, menu sounds) and a button to the sound room; the old "sound comes later" note removed; new sound icon in src/ui/icons.ts
- Save v6: settings.voiceVolume (0.9) and settings.uiVolume (0.6) with migration v5 -> v6 and test
- Test range: plays the meadow theme with wind and birds in the trees; music layers follow the combo tier, new tiers chime, key clicks carry the typed character, words ring
- Locales: sound room, theme names and moods, modes, stems, tiers, places, effects and new settings strings in Hebrew and English
- Tests: tests/unit/audio-music.test.ts (theory, click ladder, volume curve, every theme well formed and distinct, ten minutes of every theme and boss phase in tune, in time and in range, determinism, recognisable but not looping, cadences on the tonic, layering, bar-synced changes, boss phases); tests/e2e/sound.spec.ts (every theme renders clean sound without clipping and layers add to it, sound wakes only on a key, a typed streak brings in the drums on the bar and a mistake takes them out, boss phases, place sounds, four saved volumes)
- Docs: ARCHITECTURE 7d Audio and the save model, DESIGN Sound direction (how it was built), CHANGELOG, ASSETS (no audio files), ROADMAP tick

**Decisions**

- **Music layers follow the combo tier directly: ink = drone and soft harp, techelet = melody, silver = drums, gold = second voice, light = busier drums and fills** — The roadmap says stems build with the combo; using the same five tiers as the HUD combo meter makes what you see and what you hear match
- **After a mistake the layers drop back on the next bar line, with a one-beat fade, not instantly** — Errors must stay soft ("impact without punishment"); a bar-synced fade sounds musical instead of like a penalty
- **Key clicks are tuned to the theme that is playing and climb its pentatonic ladder two octaves, then back down** — A long streak then plays a melody in key with the music instead of rising out of hearing or clashing
- **Menus play the title theme quietly (melody, no drums); 3D screens and the sound room choose their own music** — Menus feel alive without being noisy; scenes stay in charge of their own sound
- **Added voiceVolume (0.9) and uiVolume (0.6) to the save as a new version (v6) with a migration** — The roadmap asks for music, effects, voice and UI volumes; menu sounds start a bit lower so they never tire
- **Voice volume is exposed as a number for speech synthesis instead of routing speech through Web Audio** — Browser speech cannot be routed through Web Audio; T35 will set the utterance volume from it
- **The AudioPort that scenes use gained playAt, section, ambience, clearAmbience and listen; the scene manager moves the ears with the camera and stops ambience on unload** — Positional sound and boss phases need these, and doing the listener and cleanup in the manager means no scene can forget them
- **Added a sound room screen (#/sound, opened from Settings > Sound)** — There are no game scenes with music yet besides the test range; the sound room lets the owner hear every theme, layer, place and effect right away
- **Quality is checked by rendering every theme offline in the browser test (real samples: not silent, no clipping, louder with more layers) plus unit tests that compose ten minutes of every theme** — An unattended run cannot listen; these checks prove the music is in tune, in time, varied and clean
- **Brushes in the hub theme swish softly through a band-pass filter instead of a bright high-pass hiss** — A spectrum check of the first version showed the hub was too hissy for a cosy room

**To do**

- [ ] Listen to the five themes in the sound room and say what to change (tempo, instruments, mood): the music was checked by measurement, not by ear
- [ ] Themes for the other regions (Forge, Shuk, Jaffa Line, Geniza, Hermon, Station, Atbash City, Midbar, Lantern Caves, Keeper) come with their scene tasks; the voice bus is used by spoken lines in T35
- [ ] The richer instrument and mix pass is part of T34 (art, lighting, VFX and music pass)

**Notes**

No typing text is produced in this task (the sound room counts any letters only for sound), so the learned-letters test does not apply. No audio files: everything is synthesized live, so the plugin stays small and offline.
